Compeq Manufacturing.why: PCB maker whose AI data-center strategy is HLC + HDI and mSAP boards for OAM, UBB, optical transceivers, switches and CPO; data-center revenue rose 182% YoY in Q2 2026 to 10% of sales
Compeq Manufacturing.evidence: Compeq August 2026 investor presentation (MOPS 231320260818E001): AI data center - HLC + HDI, HLC, mSAP for OAM, UBB, optical transceiver, switch, CPO; Q2 2026 data-center revenue +182% YoY, 10% of TWD 19,992 M revenue

players.product: HDI, high-layer-count (HLC) and mSAP substrate-like PCBs for AI data-center OAM / UBB boards, switches, optical transceivers and CPO

quarterly_data.signal: Q2 2026 revenue TWD 19,992 million, up 10% YoY (Q2 2025: TWD 18,200 million). Data Center rose to 10% of revenue (4% in Q2 2025; 5%, 6% and 7% in the three quarters between), up 182% YoY; Aerospace 22% (+9%), RF + FPC 24% (+4%), Mobile Phone 17% (+14%), SMT 13% (+8%), PC 11% (-25%), Consumer & Others 4% (+19%). H1 2026 revenue NT$39.5 billion at an 18.3% gross margin (2025: NT$76.0 billion, 18.6%).
quarterly_data.figure: Q2 2026 revenue TWD 19,992 M (+10% YoY); Data Center 10% of revenue (+182% YoY); 26H1 gross margin 18.3%

quarterly_data.signal: Compeq's PCB market strategy for AI data centers: HLC + HDI, HLC and mSAP boards for OAM, UBB, optical transceivers, switches and CPO (other markets: consumer electronics HLC + HDI / HLC for AI phones, AI PCs and AI glasses; LEO satellites HDI / RF + FPC including orbital data centers). The company cites its 20/20 um line/spacing substrate-like Anylayer boards with mSAP.

Optical transceivers: the company says demand for 400G and above optical transceivers driven by AI networking is accelerating and driving demand for high-end PCBs; Compeq has been engaged in mSAP substrate-like PCB for nearly a decade. The deck's PCB spec table: 800G modules use 12-14L boards (4-8L mSAP), 1.6T use 14-16L (6-10L mSAP) on M7+ / M8 materials; its 400G+ transceiver shipment forecast (market reports and Compeq internal data) is 52M pcs in 2025, 96M in 2026, 155M in 2027 and 178M in 2028.

Compeq has 8 facilities in Taiwan, China and Thailand and 20,000+ employees. Compeq Thailand (AIES, Samut Prakan): 300 MUSD investment on 180K SQM of land, mass production from Q1'25, capacity 400KSF/M.
quarterly_data.figure: Thailand plant: 300 MUSD investment, 400KSF/M capacity, mass production Q1'25
